patches.purpose: Sync the iframe with the dashboard's dark/light theme toggle.
patches.rationale: Upstream Plannotator is dark-only. The dashboard's theme toggle was leaving the review surface dark after switching to light mode, because the iframe is a separate document and does not inherit the dashboard's :root[data-theme] attribute.

files.review.css: Added a :root[data-theme="light"] block overriding the CSS custom properties (--bg, --panel, --text, etc.) plus overrides for hardcoded selectors (.source-line::before, .source-line:hover, .source-line.selected, button, .error, .approve).
files.review.js: Added an applyTheme() helper that mirrors the dashboard's data-theme onto the iframe's <html>. Reads theme from the URL query param on initial load and listens for pi-hive-theme postMessages for runtime toggles. The existing pi-hive-review-context handler was extended to also forward theme from event.data.theme. The duplicate message listener was removed (the original handler is now subsumed).

patches.wire: Dashboard passes ?theme=<dark|light> on the initial /pl-review/ URL via the server's POST /review-sessions body, and pushes {type: "pi-hive-theme", theme} postMessages to a mounted iframe on every theme toggle.
patches.reapply: When bumping @plannotator/pi-extension to a newer version, reapply the theme patch against the new source and refresh the SHA256s in derivedSources. Review the diff for merge conflicts; the patch is small and isolated.

patches.purpose: Recolor the .deny (Request changes) button from red to blue in both themes.
patches.rationale: The vendored Plannotator styles .deny with `color: var(--bad)` (a saturated red), which reads as a destructive action — "Request changes" is feedback signaling, not deletion. Red implied something would be lost. Blue is a deliberate-attention color that distinguishes the request-changes intent from approve (green) without alarming the reviewer.

files.review.css: Changed `.deny{color:var(--bad)}` to `.deny{color:#6ea8fe}` for dark mode and added `:root[data-theme="light"] .deny{color:#2563eb}` for light mode. No background/border change — kept the secondary-button treatment.

patches.wire: N/A — purely visual recolor of an existing button. The button still posts `type: "plan_review_denied"` to the dashboard on click, identical behavior to upstream.
patches.reapply: When bumping @plannotator/pi-extension to a newer version, check if the upstream `.deny` rule has changed (e.g., upstream might add a hover state). Reapply the per-theme color override if the structure still matches.

patches.purpose: Remove the rid (changeId#artifactFile) text from the iframe header.
patches.rationale: Upstream Plannotator renders `<changeId>#<artifactFile>` next to the "Plan artifact review" title. The dashboard already shows the changeId in the plan-head-title above the iframe AND the artifact file name in the plan-review-bar inside the iframe — the rid in the header is redundant noise for the dashboard's UX. The rid is still encoded in the URL (used by `/api/plan` to fetch the artifact) so this is purely a visual removal.
